DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

The combination of fever, altered mental status, profound muscle rigidity (indicated by general rigidity and high CK), and your history of haloperidol use strongly supports this diagnosis. The presence of profuse sweating and autonomic instability further confirms the clinical picture.
